collection_batch_accounts_route_snapshot.name: collection_batch_accounts_route_snapshot_chk
collection_batch_accounts_route_snapshot.value: ("collection_batch_accounts"."address_snapshot" is null and "collection_batch_accounts"."current_bill_centavos_snapshot" is null and "collection_batch_accounts"."arrears_centavos_snapshot" is null) or ("collection_batch_accounts"."address_snapshot" is not null and "collection_batch_accounts"."current_bill_centavos_snapshot" >= 0 and "collection_batch_accounts"."arrears_centavos_snapshot" >= 0 and "collection_batch_accounts"."current_bill_centavos_snapshot" + "collection_batch_accounts"."arrears_centavos_snapshot" = "collection_batch_accounts"."expected_centavos")

service_plans_speed_channels_positive_ch.name: service_plans_speed_channels_positive_chk
service_plans_speed_channels_positive_ch.value: ("service_plans"."internet_speed_mbps" is null or "service_plans"."internet_speed_mbps" > 0) and ("service_plans"."cable_channel_count" is null or "service_plans"."cable_channel_count" > 0)

payments_reference_chk.name: payments_reference_chk
payments_reference_chk.value: ("payments"."method" = 'CASH' and "payments"."normalized_external_reference" is null) or ("payments"."method" = 'GCASH' and "payments"."normalized_external_reference" is not null)
